title: Independently replay the L20 triple-four exclusion through five-source lifts
body:
PR4207 open question1 requests a second native implementation of the still single-code L20 `(4,4,4,2^4)` full-cover exclusion. This supplies that replay using **Nick Petalas's suggested five-source/two-lift route**. The predecessor native implementation, driver and verifier were not read/imported by the new implementation or oracle.

Actual full C++17 enumeration:51,975 five-source classes/1,257 full30 cores;2,287,740 six-source insertions/17,152 raw full56 covers/8,576 canonical covers, each appearing twice;41,550,720 final candidate lifts, zero full98, filtered maximum95 at940 raw lifts. A separately frozen matching-based Python oracle agrees on the whole five-source histogram. Every retained six-source word and both fourfold projections are independently checked. Written projection/quotient completeness connects the candidate enumeration to profile-wide **no98**. The95maximum is conditional on full56 projections and is **not** asserted for all profile words.

Four stdlib-only registered normal/strict-optimized checks cover the core oracle, authenticated native receipt, complete retained six-word list/projections and corruption controls. A focused native workflow runs two **complete** C++17 replays, comparing every output byte with the frozen receipt, then checks committed inputs unchanged. Generic Python CI does not substitute for that native job. Python3.12 plus system `c++` for full native replay; no library dependencies. Reproduce from repository root:

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/seven-source-lift-replay
python3.12 -I -B research/seven-source-lift-replay/native_replay.py
```

Canonical main12fa8c5c844be21bfefb38a19503fbd867a11244, priority7; predecessor4207 head5da1b72f18915820618d14905ad01422ec0a8246. Two unchanged model/census exports retain source paths/hashes and own-branch ancestorc0fcafa8a0acf438fb721c1862f19a8eebcbf142. Task `connector-alphabet-change` is **changed** to this explicit independent audit in the excluded fixed alphabet; no mechanism expansion. [Claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/4207#issuecomment-6295775919). Fresh324 open/draft bodies, hub and parent comments checked; broader overlap partial. [James Reed's earlier review](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/4207#issuecomment-6294899460) explicitly leaves this large native step open and is separately credited.

Remaining: L16/L18 billion-class native rows, complete218-call theorem recertification, downstream216-use audit, changed alphabet, supplier/physical/native/outer multiplication consequences. No new kappa, frontier change, merge or closure of others' work. Maintainer edits disabled. README Open next questions identifies one separately budgeted native row or one actual downstream caller.

Credit Nick Petalas/4207 for source exclusion, replay request and suggested route; nightangelflowerwin-ops/4079/3780, commdata2338/2397, Cinna Davis/2229/2236, Ross Richardson/943 and James Reed/rcfc-jreed for the retained lineage and separate audit.
